summary: Frontend-only testing for the NEW Point Detail modal feature + regression for 9 carriers (Vinted Go + Amazon) and total ~4112. All 11 scenarios PASSED. Detail modal opens from list card click AND map marker click; renders name/carrier/type-badge/address/coords(6-decimals)/phone/hours(3 rows: Lundi-Vendredi, Samedi, Dimanche); Itinéraire opens Google Maps directions in a new tab; Favori logged-out triggers login prompt; Fermer button closes the modal. critical_code_review_comments: AuthModal (rendered when detail-fav-btn is clicked while logged out) has no data-testid on its close button — Escape key doesn't close it either. Users on logged-out state can dismiss only via backdrop click or the X button (no aria-label testid). Consider adding data-testid='auth-close-btn' and keydown Escape handler for keyboard accessibility.

PointDetail.js line 98 relies on point.lat / point.lng being numbers. If backend ever returns them as strings, .toFixed(6) would throw. Currently OK — backend returns floats. Minor hardening: Number(point.lat).toFixed(6).

PointDetail.js line 117: `point.hours[d.key] || 'Fermé'` — good defensive default. But comparison `val.toLowerCase() === 'fermé'` is fine for exact match; if backend ever returns 'FERMÉ' or 'closed', styling would drop. Non-blocking.

MapApp.js line 531-537: PointDetail always renders with `point={selected}`. When user clicks a marker AND then filters change and remove that point from `visiblePoints`, the modal still shows stale data. Minor UX; not a bug per spec.

PointCard.js and PointDetail.js both duplicate the fav+route logic (google maps URL, favorite toggle w/ toast). Consider extracting shared handlers into a hook (usePointActions) — DRY improvement, ~40 lines saved.

The desktop <aside> panel covers Leaflet's default zoom control (top-left of map at x=0..400). The zoom buttons are effectively unreachable from the panel side. Consider setting Leaflet zoomControl position to 'topright' or adding padding. Regression risk: user cannot zoom in via UI on desktop unless they scroll-wheel. Minor UX.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Point Detail modal is complete and working end-to-end. Total 4112, Vinted Go=436, Amazon=456, Lyon=114. Modal testids: point-detail, detail-name, detail-type ('Locker'|'Point relais'), detail-address, detail-coords (6-decimal 'lat, lng'), detail-phone (optional), detail-hours (3 direct child divs: Lundi–Vendredi | Samedi | Dimanche), detail-route-btn (opens google.com/maps/dir new tab), detail-fav-btn (opens AuthModal when logged-out), detail-close-btn. Both list-card click (aside [data-testid^='point-card-']) and Leaflet marker click (.leaflet-marker-pane .leaflet-marker-icon:not(.marker-cluster)) open the modal via MapApp.selectPoint. To interact with map markers: search a city first (e.g. Lyon) to auto-zoom, then iterate through non-cluster markers whose bounding_box().x > 420 (right of the aside). Leaflet zoom-control at top-left is covered by aside — cannot be clicked; use map._leaflet_map.setZoom() via JS if needed. AuthModal has no testid on close/no Escape handler — minor accessibility issue noted in code-review comments.
